candidates.summary: A multi-line /*line ...*/ block in doc position is blanked to an empty interior that formatDocComment collapses, so every later position moves up, further than the unneutralized directive moved it
candidates.failure_scenario:
A .gno file with a parenthesized import block and a doc-position `/*line a
b
c
d
f.gno:9:1*/` before a func: the 12-line source transpiles to a 9-line body (unneutralized: 14), so `go build` on the .gen.go reports every error after that comment 3 lines above its real .gno line. The ADR's table names this exact shape as restored to parity, and the go:generate path keeps a marker line for this reason while this path writes "/*" + "
"*(n-1) + "*/"
